feedback: User requests actual bare 64x96/1x faceless/hairless/clothesless base with featureless skin-colored pelvis, fixed dimensions/masks/settings before generation
prior_failures: Part ownership removed eyes with hair
Clothed or face-bearing replacement was incorrectly proposed
Uncontrolled tall muscular body and noisy alpha
change_scope: Fixed 17-part ownership plus protected scalp/pelvis/outer edge
ComfyUI proposes interior shading only; geometry never fitted to generation

regressions.dimensions: Exact fixed full-body and per-owner visible bounds; scalp8/chin28/soles91; never per-part fit
regressions.face_identity: Base head contains no features, all head pixels protected; no face/hair layers
regressions.color_texture: Declared six-color warm skin palette; no clothing-coded material; inspect clusters at1x/8x
regressions.alpha_edges: Binary alpha exact authored silhouette, 4px minimum margin, white/black/checker review
regressions.part_ownership: 17 fixed unique owners, isolated part/removal/reconstruction review; no color classification
regressions.occlusion: Front neutral only; no hidden surface reconstruction or moving limb claimed

retained_decisions.selection: One shared selection ID resolves authored small/portrait parts; no automatic shrinking
retained_decisions.base: Bare skin-colored body, featureless pelvis; no face, hair, underwear or equipment baked in
retained_decisions.masks: Separate ownership, skin/lacquer palette, occlusion, control/weights, joint overlap and hidden construction
retained_decisions.safety: No native mouse tools; no cursor or OS input setting changes
retained_decisions.preservation: No existing files deleted; main/design/foundation/Confirmed unchanged
